rigid_screen.scope: Selected rigid interfaces, sampled at the times listed in counts. Includes prior motion/support scenarios and new hardware versus surrounding parts and header clamps versus process heads, rotor and guards. New hardware scenarios use 0.05 s. Exact same-joint fastener meshes and designated plate/lug mates are excluded from collision screening; actual target bores and stack faces are checked separately in check-hardware19. Existing explicit bearing/nut/follower mates are excluded. Broad phase skips AABB overlap below 0.2 mm. Flexible leaves, film, hoses, continuous sweep, tolerances and remaining full-machine interfaces are not validated.

summary: R19细化18处接头、40套穿栓与40根空心型材；保留13组滑台等安装细节。基础17 组机构支承/动力/传动记录，10310/10557 条结构零件已关联记录；推杆退让与高位回程、分度前拨叉退出及局部网格检查通过。记录关联不等于紧固、载荷或整机无干涉验收。四列包装对接仍待重构。
